item.title: Pavement width reduced by empty treepit root suckers - new tree requested, 1st August
item.description:
We have a vacant tree pit outside 49/51 Byne Road. The roots of the previous tree were never properly removed. The roots have been sending up a bush of 140cm suckers ever since, which creates an unsightly impediment to passers by and reduces the width of the pavement. This year, we tried reducing the suckers to one in the hope it would become a tree, but this has not succeeded and the pit is just a mass of large weeds. Please can the roots be properly removed and a new tree, such as a whitebeam, be provided? We do not want the tree pit to be capped. We want a new tree, preferably a whitebeam since it is drought tolerant and will provide good shade to the neighbouring houses and to us walking along our pavement.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 53, Byne Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
